source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Redman's 202 and the majority of 72 read from the page image; Devlin's 130 is 202 less 72

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1961: the only contest was Annaghmore. In five divisions no nomination was received and the outgoing members were declared elected. The reports read name only the four new members and the Annaghmore candidates; the other 26 members (21 returned unopposed, five deemed re-elected) are not named. Polled 1 June 1961. Redman, the sitting member, stood as an unofficial Unionist against the official Unionist candidate; 332 on the register.
